options.text: In a large number of cases
options.explanation: In a large number of cases — in many individual cases within a set or group。這個表達強調案例數量多；如果重點是不同類型／不同情境，wide range / situations 更貼切。
In many situations — across a large number of situations or circumstances。這個表達強調不同情況，不等於統計或個案數量很多。

options.text: In a wide range of cases
options.explanation: In a wide range of cases ✓ — across many different kinds of cases。這句的決定性線索是 coverage across varied settings is central。因此 In a wide range of cases 最準確表達這種 in many cases。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。

words.example: More often than not, a short explanation is enough.

falseSynonyms.zh: 總是 ≠ in many cases always 表示所有情況，強度過高。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Always means without exception.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常 ≠ in many cases usually 常暗示大多數情況；in many cases 不一定達到『通常』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Usually is stronger in frequency.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有時 ≠ in many cases sometimes 通常比 in many cases 弱得多。
一般而言 ≠ in many cases generally 是整體概括，不一定指多個具體案例。
只在頻率 sense 接近 frequently 不保留『多個案例』的框架。
只在普遍性 sense 接近 commonly 偏 widespread/usual，而不是單純 case count。
多數情況 ≠ in many cases in most cases 強度更高，明確表示 majority。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Most is stronger than many.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數與詞義陷阱 case 可指情況、個案、案件；要按語境理解。
